Purpose

Capital Management is one of the key strategic priorities of the Bank. The incumbent will be a critical member of the Capital Policy and Planning team and will support processes that provide capital relevant information to Executive Management to assist them in making strategic decisions that impact the Bank. This will require the incumbent to build, enhance and maintain appropriate data that is integrated with other information used for decision-making purposes and for periodic reporting to OSFI. A key requirement of this role will be to provide support to the Director Capital Policy and Planning and the VP Capital Management to respond to leadership requests for capital related analysis/information, on an as-required and time-sensitive basis.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Forecasting and Planning - Methodology and Model Development:

  • Provide analytic skills to challenge Capital forecast assumption and provide firmer methodology background for analytical models. Support calibration of complex capital allocation parameters (e.g. for Client Profitability Calibration tied to Forecasts)
  • Connect to new FRM team under Group Treasury to align on methodology and approaches for optimizing Financial Resource Management and Allocation.
  • Provide support for Capital Forecasting to be scoped in formally for Model Governance (under E-23).
  • Improve Automation of Capital Forecasting Process and BCAR Validation Processes.

Forecasting and Planning – Execution and Reporting:

  • Provide Support for team on regular activities: Develop, enhance and maintain capital forecasting models for the Bank's monthly forecasts, OSFI quarterly multi-year forecast, Enterprise-Wide Stress Testing (EWST), Recovery and Resolution plans and Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Report (ICAAR). This includes coordinating with multiple stakeholders to obtain inputs, compiling data from many sources (spreadsheet based), performing complex calculations, summarizing Capital and Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) impacts and performing analysis to assess impact under Basel III and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare summaries and presentations to Senior Executives to illustrate capital and RWA information, changes and drivers; Provide analytic support to respond to senior executives’ questions and/or what-if scenarios; and address any requests for expanded information from, OSFI or other regulatory bodies.
  • Leverage data and analytics to provide insightful summaries and presentations for the impact of capital or RWA movements, regulatory changes, acquisitions and what-if scenarios on capital ratios.
  • Enhance and maintain Business Lines Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) reports and track RWA growth and impact on capital ratio; and migrate the reporting data to a Power BI and/or other platforms for Business Lines consumption.

Support to Partners:

  • Establish strong partnership within relevant departments across the Bank to ensure that assumptions are current and accurate and deliver promptly capital ratios’ projection.
  • Work closely with Strategic Transaction Review to support the Bank's acquisitions/divestitures/restructuring initiatives through the preparation of scenario analysis for capital ratio impact and plausible stress scenarios; and work closely with Group Treasury - Term Funding to ensure alignment with bank funding and provide frequent updates to executive management.

Operational Efficiency and Continuous Improvement:

  • Implement best in class data management practices and continuously strive to improve, simplify and streamline forecasting models and process. Refine forecasting models and data repositories to ensure clarity of complex calculations and assumptions.
  • Develop and maintain a current knowledge base of Basel III rules. Leverage the knowledge in the development of a forward-looking analysis and projections.
  • Assist the Director in building process documentation for the team's deliverables; in completing other deliverables to OSFI and/or Senior Management, on an as-required basis

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

  • Graduate degree in Finance, Business or Economics. Graduate or undergraduate degree in mathematical or scientific discipline.
  • 5-7 years’ experience in financial Modeling, financial analysis, data analytics or risk modeling.
  • Strong financial acumen and deep understanding of forecasting & planning process, finance systems (SmartView, Hyperion, OBI), and data management principles.
  • Advanced skills in Excel, VBA, SQL, Access, Power BI; and ability to apply best data management practices to large data sets and develop new models, refine existing models and processes.
  • Strong Methodology Background with track record of challenging and solving complex business and financial modelling assumptions in a real setting
  • In depth knowledge of capital concepts (Basel III, risk weight asset, risk modelling)
  • Ability to multi-task in a time-sensitive environment and high degree of flexibility and adaptability
  • Strong analytical and research skills and ability to synthesize high quality presentations and excel summaries.
  • Excellent ability to produce clear, presentable, and traceable excel files that can be shared with executive management and interpreted easily.

What’s in it for you?

  • The opportunity to join a forward-thinking company surrounded by a collaborative team of innovative thinkers.

  • Internal development to support your growth and enhance your skills.
  • A competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Senior Design Specialist - Strategic Projects
description:
Description

OUR TEAM AND WHAT WE\'LL ACCOMPLISH TOGETHER

The Strategic Projects team is at the forefront of TELUS\'s network evolution, delivering transformational initiatives that will reshape how we connect Canadians. As a Senior Design Specialist, you\'ll play a pivotal role in architecting, designing, and delivering solutions such as Satellite direct-to-cell, 5G Network slicing, connected cars, and other emerging technologies. You\'ll work autonomously across CTO, Business, CIO, Regulatory, and Legal stakeholders to translate competing priorities into cohesive technical solutions, making critical architectural decisions that will define our network\'s future.

WHAT YOU\'LL DO

  • Architect and design end-to-end solutions for emerging network technologies (Satellite direct-to-cell, 5G Network slicing, connected cars) that align with TELUS\'s strategic roadmap and technical standards
  • Lead cross-functional design reviews and technical discussions with CTO, Business, CIO, Regulatory, and Legal stakeholders to translate LTE/5G technical aspects into business impact and gather requirements that inform architectural decisions
  • Develop detailed technical specifications, design documents, and architectural diagrams that translate complex requirements into implementable solutions, including validation of vendor compliance to industry and TELUS standards
  • Conduct lab proof-of-concept testing and interoperability testing to validate emerging technologies, evaluate vendor solutions, and identify optimization opportunities aligned with 3GPP specifications and RAN best practices
  • Proactively communicate TELUS requirements to vendors, evaluate responses, and propose solutions and feature optimization engineering guidelines that support field teams and operational excellence
  • Drive independent decision-making on architectural trade-offs, technical feasibility, and implementation approaches in a fast-paced environment, while providing technical guidance and support to engineering teams
  • Stay informed of the latest wireless technology developments (5G evolution, O-RAN, Network slicing, SDN/virtualization, AI & Machine learning) and establish design best practices that elevate the organization\'s technical capabilities

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of experience in wireless communication industry with deep expertise across RAN, core network, and transport architecture
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with LTE/5G network design, optimization, and technology introduction across multiple network domains (RAN, core, transport)
  • Solid understanding of 3GPP specifications and how they apply across the full network stack (air interface, RRM, MM, RF compliance, core protocols)
  • Demonstrated expertise in emerging network technologies including O-RAN, V-RAN, SDN/virtualization, and cloud technology, with strong understanding of industry evolution and future network trends
  • Real-world experience architecting, designing, or implementing 5G Network slicing solutions with operators, including deep understanding of slicing architecture, orchestration, and operational models
  • Hands-on experience with Satellite direct-to-cell technology architecture and integration with terrestrial networks
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into business impact and communicate architectural decisions across diverse stakeholder groups (technical and non-technical)
  • Proactive, self-directed approach to problem-solving with ability to make independent architectural decisions in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
  • Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

GREAT-TO-HAVES

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships and influence across diverse stakeholder groups (technical and non-technical, internal and external), with proven success navigating competing priorities and driving consensus
  • Demonstrated skill in breaking down complex technical problems into understandable components and communicating solutions in a way that resonates with audiences at all levels
  • Familiarity with vendor management and RFP evaluation processes for network infrastructure and emerging technology solutions

title: Senior Delivery Manager (Technology Financial Reporting)

Sr. Manager Technology Financial Reporting

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Manager to lead financial management, reporting, governance, and analytics across Scotiabank's Technology portfolio. This role delivers accurate, timely, and well-controlled financial insights that enable Chief Information Officers (CIOs), Technology leaders, and Finance partners to strengthen governance, forecasting, and strategic decision-making. As a proactive people leader, you will guide a cross-functional reporting and analytics team while serving as a trusted advisor to senior executives, ensuring alignment between strategic technology investments and business objectives.

The successful candidate will bring strong financial management expertise, advanced analytical capabilities, executive communication skills, and experience operating within complex technology delivery environments.

What Will You Do?

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Analysis

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities across technology portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Develop and manage annual operating and capital budgets.
  • Perform variance analysis, cost-to-complete forecasting, and financial modelling to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end financial close processes.
  • Provide financial recommendations that support portfolio investment and funding decisions.

Program Financial Management

  • Maintain end-to-end financial oversight of technology projects, portfolios, and funding allocations.
  • Monitor project budgets, expenditures, accruals, invoice approvals, budget reconciliations, and financial controls.
  • Ensure accurate tracking of technology modernization, Software Currency, infrastructure, cybersecurity, remediation, and decommissioning costs.
  • Identify potential budget overruns and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure alignment between portfolio funding, financial plans, and technology delivery objectives.

Financial Reporting & Governance

  • Own end-to-end CIO and technology portfolio financial reporting, ensuring outputs are accurate, complete, timely, and decision-ready.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and executive financial reporting packages and governance materials.
  • Oversee reconciliation across SIP reporting, funding envelopes, portfolio reporting, and enterprise financial reporting views.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for portfolio financial reporting and governance inquiries.
  • Support benefits realization reporting, KPI tracking, and portfolio performance measurement.

Data, Tools & Automation

  • Govern and enhance financial data extracts, reporting processes, and automation solutions.
  • Ensure financial data integrity, consistency, reconciliation, and reporting accuracy across multiple sources.
  • Utilize and optimize reporting solutions using Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, CA PPM, and other enterprise reporting platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to financial data management and reporting capabilities.

Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that transform portfolio financial data into actionable executive insights.
  • Develop reporting metrics and visualizations that support governance and decision-making.
  • Provide detailed financial analyses, trends, forecasts, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Deliver executive-level reporting that enhances transparency across strategic technology investments.

Governance, Controls & Compliance

  • Ensure financial activities comply with Bank policies, internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Support internal and external audits through documentation, reporting validation, and financial evidence.
  • Oversee capital versus operating expense classifications and related reporting requirements.
  • Identify exceptions to policies, controls, and procedures and escalate as required.
  • Promote effective and efficient operations aligned with Scotiabank's Values, Code of Conduct, and operational risk expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership & Team Enablement

  • Facilitate forecasting, accrual, budget, and reporting discussions with key stakeholders.
  • Resolve reporting and financial data issues while continuously improving reporting outcomes.
  • Present financial updates, risks, recommendations, and strategic insights to senior executives and governance forums.
  • Lead and develop team capability through coaching, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and performance management.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.

Role Dimensions

  • Financial governance and reporting for strategic technology investment portfolios.
  • Support for technology transformation, Software Currency, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, and enterprise remediation initiatives.
  • Portfolio budgets ranging from tens of millions to over $1 billion in technology investments.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Technology, Business, Finance, Risk, Procurement, and Operations.
  • Oversight of multiple concurrent financial reporting priorities and strategic workstreams.
  • Leadership of reporting, analytics, and financial governance activities supporting multi-region stakeholders.
  • Accountability for adherence to enterprise governance, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support for executive-level decision-making through reporting, forecasting, and financial insight generation.

Education

  • CPA, CFA, MBA, or other relevant professional designation is considered an asset.

Experience

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale technology portfolios, enterprise transformation programs, or strategic investment initiatives.
  • Proven experience managing budgets and financial reporting for complex technology programs.

  • Demonstrated success partnering with executive stakeholders and senior technology leaders.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience within a Canadian banking or financial services environment is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong financial modelling and business analysis capabilities.
  • Power BI dashboard design and reporting expertise.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills for executive reporting and presentations.
  • Experience with CA Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tools.
  • Experience working with financial systems, portfolio management tools, and reporting platforms.
  • Experience with Alteryx for data preparation and workflow automation is considered an asset.

Other Qualifications

  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced, complex, and evolving environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to influence outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.

Key Competencies

  • Financial Reporting & Analytics
  • Forecasting & Budget Management

Standardize proposal and investment data management for domestic and international wealth channels
• Manage the day-to-day delivery of the standardized proposal service offering, including workflow coordination, quality oversight, and execution support for investment proposals, external account reviews, and related client-facing content across wealth channels.

Platform support, reporting and tools for domestic and international wealth distribution channels

• Support the evolution of data management capabilities, including governance, control frameworks, and process standardization, to improve trust in data used across proposals, reporting, and analytical outputs.

Contribute to the positive reputation and effective functioning of the Portfolio Insights and Analytics team by:
• Staying informed on capital markets and industry developments
• Handling all inquiries in a professional, timely, and client focused manner
• Providing thorough, thoughtful, and accurate responses to all client inquiries ensuring proper follow-through on all resolutions

• Facilitating a culture of open and honest communication

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We would love to work with you if you have:

• Over 5 years of investment related experience with understanding of financial markets and portfolio management theory
• Experience working effectively with Advisors, Relationship Managers, and Portfolio Managers, with a strong understanding of wealth management channels and client service requirements.

As the Senior Analyst, Data Management, Quality & Controls, you will support a forward-looking, multi-year Investment Platform Transformation Program designed to modernize the target operating model and strengthen end-to-end technology and data capabilities. This role reports into the Transformation Office Program, with oversight from the Director, Data Operations, and is important because it will help build sustainable data quality controls, monitoring, reporting and operational processes that improve decision-making across investment, operations and finance teams.

In this role, you will help design, implement and continuously improve reference data quality capabilities, with hands-on focus on data analysis, profiling, validation, issue remediation and control automation. You will partner with Data Operations, Data Governance, Technology, business stakeholders and external partners where required to establish scalable dashboards, controls and documentation, and to support the successful transition of capabilities to the Functional Data Operations team for ongoing execution within the target operating model.

You will be responsible for:

  • Support the design and implementation of a data quality framework, including rules, controls, thresholds, issue workflows and remediation processes aligned to the transformation program.

  • Develop automated and repeatable data quality checks using Python and SQL to validate the completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness of critical reference data.

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into data quality KPIs, trends, defects and remediation progress.

  • Partner with Data Operations, Data Governance, Technology and business stakeholders to define critical data elements, business rules and data acceptance criteria.

  • Support root cause analysis and resolution of data defects in collaboration with upstream and downstream stakeholders.

Required Skills & Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Accounting or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in data quality, data management, analytics or a related discipline, including experience supporting transformation or operational improvement initiatives.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, Power BI and Informatica, with practical experience building automated checks, dashboards, data quality rules and exception-handling processes.

  • Strong experience with data profiling, validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis, dashboard development and data quality controls.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across business, technology, data operations and data governance teams.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization and communication skills, with a high degree of attention to detail.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with investment platforms and data environments across IBOR and ABOR, such as Aladdin, CRD, Calypso or Eagle PACE.

At Roche, we believe that every patient deserves access to life-changing innovations. As a global healthcare leader operating across pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we combine cutting-edge science, advanced technology, and a passion for improving lives to address some of the world’s most challenging medical needs. Driven by our commitment to research and sustainable healthcare solutions, we foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where diverse teams are empowered to question the status quo, drive continuous improvement, and redefine what is possible in modern medicine.

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML & Digital Quality Lead to provide Quality Assurance oversight and guidance while designing and implementing cutting-edge AI/ML Digital solutions in a GMP Environment. If you have a passion for innovation and a proven track record in implementing AI/ML systems, this role is made for you.

Do you bring experience in implementing or enabling the qualifications of digital solutions, preferably in the pharma industry, and are you looking for an impactful role? We seek an individual with excellent knowledge of the pharma data ecosystem, informatics systems, tools, and techniques with a focus on quality and compliance. As the AI/ML Compliance Lead you will work with the business, data scientists, and IT to design, validate, implement and support in operation Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Systems to fulfill GMP business objectives. By working closely with technical teams, you will ensure AI/ML solutions are accurate, efficient, scalable, secure, and validated for GMP use.

The Opportunity

  • Lead the Quality Assurance oversight, validation, and compliant execution of cutting-edge AI/ML systems within a regulated GxP and GMP business environment.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, software development, and IT teams to integrate AI/ML algorithms into business applications under a standard Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) framework.

  • Author, review, and approve critical validation documentation, including validation plans, technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, and test scripts.

  • Identify and proactively mitigate quality, security, and data privacy risks across the full AI/ML lifecycle, addressing issues such as model drift, dataset bias, and validation boundaries.

  • Influence and align diverse technical and operational stakeholders across global business units to establish compliant validation strategies for advanced digital solutions.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that streamline CSV/CSA processes, integrating emerging AI risk management frameworks into existing quality management systems.

  • Mentor and coach colleagues across Digital Compliance and broader Quality functions, fostering an agile mindset and supporting capability building in digital validation.

Who you are

  • You possess proven hands-on experience designing, validating, or implementing AI/ML systems in commercial environments, including deep learning, NLP, LLMs, and AI agentic workflows.

  • You are deeply knowledgeable in FDA/EMA pharmaceutical regulations, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and core Quality Risk Management principles (ICH Q9 / ICH Q10).

  • You bring functional expertise in programming languages (e.g., Python, R) along with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and MLOps practices for model governance in production.

  • You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complex digital quality issues and manage risk with high autonomy.

  • You are an exceptional communicator and influencer who can translate complex technical AI/ML compliance concepts to build consensus across cross-functional teams.

  • You embody Roche’s core mindsets of inclusivity, speaking up, continuous learning, shared accountability, and outcome-focused collaboration.

**This role is not eligible for relocation**

At CN, we are committed to our pursuit ofexcellence. We take pride in delivering work of the highest standard,continually innovating to shape the railroad of the future. As responsiblerailroaders, we make the right decisions every time, putting safety first,acting with unwavering integrity, and holding ourselves accountable for ouractions. We believe in succeeding together—by fostering inclusivity andcollaboration, we sustainably deliver exceptional results for ourcustomers.
We welcome students aboard to join our team andplay a valuable role in the engine that keeps the North American economy ontrack. Expect an exciting environment where you’ll be encouraged to learn,grow, and be recognized for your unique ideas and contributions. Work onpivotal projects with experienced collaborators who will encourage you to shareyour perspectives, and thrive in our close-knit, safety-focused culture. Thecareers we offer are meaningful because the work we do matters. Join us and getyour career moving!

This is a full-time summer internship lasting from May 11, 2026, until August 28, 2026.

Job Summary

The Intern, Supply Chain is responsible for improving Bulk performance by augmenting CN’s reliance on technology and automating current processes. The role allows the selected individual to explore the many dimensions of the Supply Chain field, learn and apply different business analysis concepts and use their computer skills to improve CN’s Bulk programs. During the internship, the manager provides guidance and expertise throughout to ensure successful implementation of these projects. The incumbent uses their initiative and communication skills and drives for continuous improvement to ensure the project achieves the agreed upon milestones.

Major Responsibilities

· Design Bulk Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) dashboards in Power BI

· Refine and automate commodity specific daily reports

· Collaborate with the different program leads on the metrics for their programs and where the data is housed

· Collect the KPIs data from multiple platforms for dashboarding and Power BI

· Support monitoring system performance, identifying operational improvements

· Support moving existing external Power BI dashboard, if applicable, in-house

· Prioritize and plan a roll-out strategy

· Train defined team on the use and maintenance of the dashboard

· Prepare training material to support users in dashboard use and maintenance

· Redesign Bulk SharePoint site

· Compare Bulk site to other SharePoint sites to identify best practices and opportunities for improvement

· Complete stakeholder analysis to determine user needs

· Participate in data collection, analysis, and interpretation to aid in project development, performance evaluation, and regulatory compliance

· Contribute to the preparation of technical reports, presentations, and documentation for internal teams and clients

· Engage in cross-functional teamwork, sharing insights, and proposing innovative solutions to address challenges

· Adhere to safety protocols, company policies, and industry standards throughout the internship

· Stay informed about advancements in the field and recommend strategies for continuous process improvement

· Support the identification and implementation of best practices in Bulk Supply Chain Management

Requirements

· Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

· Looks for opportunities for continuous improvement and takes initiative

· Strong academic foundation with a genuine interest in sustainable solutions and supply chain management

· Proficiency in analytical thinking, problem-solving, and the ability to approach challenges creatively

· Adaptability to a fast-paced environment and capacity to manage multiple tasks effectively

· Initiative and eagerness to learn from industry professionals and contribute to projects

· Experience through internships or coursework related to the field*

· Knowledge of SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau*

· Knowledge of Systems, Applications, and Products (SAP)

Education

· Working towards a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Information and Technology Management, Business Technology Management, or Supply Chain Management

*Any experience/education/skills/knowledge for these above would be considered as an asset

This position is for students who self‑identify as First Nations, Inuit, and/or Métis, the Indigenous peoples of Canada. Through this initiative, CN is taking proactive measures to support the equitable representation of Indigenous peoples within its workforce in accordance with the Employment Equity Act.

About CN

CN is a premium railroad that sustainably generates value for our customers, shareholders, employees, and stakeholders with an unwavering commitment to safety and service. Essential to the economy, to the customers, and to the communities it serves, CN safely transports more than 300 million tons of natural resources, manufactured products, and finished goods throughout North America every year. CN\'s network connects Canada\'s Eastern and Western coasts with the U.S. South through a 20,000-mile rail network. CN and its affiliates have been contributing to community prosperity and sustainable trade since 1919. CN powers the North American economy and is committed to programs supporting social responsibility and environmental stewardship.

At CN, we are dedicated to building North America\'s safest, most inclusive and sustainable railroad, which includes reflecting the communities in which we operate. Accelerate Your Career in Agriculture. The Commercial Accelerate Program: Agriculture offers a dynamic start to your career at Scotiabank. The role supports a fast‑paced, regulation‑heavy stress testing function that designs scenarios, analyzes results, and prepares insights for senior leaders across Capital Markets and Risk. It requires a highly reliable, detail‑oriented, and analytically strong individual who can explain complex concepts clearly while maintaining humility and a collaborative mindset. The position offers significant exposure to all asset classes, senior executives, and the Market Risk oversight teams, effectively operating as the right hand of your leader. Ideal candidates bring NG system knowledge or market risk experience, value work‑life balance despite occasional late hours, and thrive in a fast paced culture without ego or pretense.

Supports the research and development of stress testing and scenario analysis methodologies and related strategies in support of the management of risks arising from changes in the market and external environment for business/group portfolios and products. Applies knowledge of analytics algorithms and technologies to develop models, methodologies and supplementary stress testing tools and infrastructures that assess the impact of a stress on risk capital and ensure risks are properly identified, understood and risk related strategies are enabled. Summarizes statistical findings, draws business conclusions, and presents actionable business recommendations used in the management of risks and related activities e.g. defining tolerance for adverse outcomes, capital modelling, assess capital and liquidity, recovery actions, portfolio and risk management strategies and tactics.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor to assigned business/group.
  • Influences and negotiates to achieve business objectives.
  • Recommends and implements solutions based on analysis of issues and implications for the business.
  • Assists in the development of strategic plans.
  • Identifies emerging issues and trends to inform decision-making.
  • Researches existing or emerging requirements & related best practices to assist and develops recommendations for changes/enhancements.
  • Assists with the interpretation of new or changing regulations and assessing impacts to the governance frameworks.
  • Helps determine business priorities and best sequence for execution of business/group strategy.
  • Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.
  • Leads the development and maintenance of stress testing and scenario analysis methodologies and frameworks.
  • Ensures alignment between stakeholders.
  • Represents the stress testing and scenario analysis function during internal/external regulatory audits and/or examinations.
  • Coordinates the management of databases; ensures alignment and integration of data in adherence with data governance standards.

  • Leads or participates in defining the communication plan designed to positively influence or change behaviour; develops tailored messaging; and identifies appropriate distribution channels.
  • Leads and integrates the monitoring, measurement & reporting on the status of the stress testing and scenario analysis program to internal & external stakeholders.
  • May provide specialized support for other internal and external regulatory requirements.
  • Provides input into the planning and implementation of ongoing operational programs in support of the stress testing and scenario analysis framework.
  • Leads/participates in the design, implementation and management of core business/group processes.
  • Works with stakeholders to identify the business requirements, understand the distinct problems, and the expected outcomes; models and frames business scenarios which impact critical business processes and/or decisions.
  • Administers and evaluates changes to stress scenarios and / or model parameters in response to changes in the market and the external environment.
  • Identifies where corrective actions are required and escalates per guidelines; ensures corrective action is taken as necessary.
  • Works with various data owners to discover and select available data sources from internal sources and external vendors (e.g. lending system, payment system, external credit rating system) to fulfill analytical needs.
  • Consults with stakeholders to improve consistency and transparency of risk measurement, metrics and reporting.
  • Develops and maintains in-depth knowledge of business and related risk management requirements and legislative/ regulatory directives and guidance.
  • Supports the management of governance meetings (e.g. committee, management, board meetings, etc.) as required; facilitates development and approval of agendas, gathering and distribution of documentation related to agendas, and creation of meeting minutes/output.
  • Builds effective relationships with internal/external stakeholders.
  • Ensures alignment between stakeholders.
  • Analyzes data and information to provide insights and recommendations
  • Monitors and tracks performance; addresses any issues.
  • Leads/participates in the design, implementation and management of core business/group processes.
  • Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
  • Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.
  • Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.
  • Works independently and regularly handles non-routine situations.
  • Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
  • Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

    Qualifications:

  • Typically between 5 - 7 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • In-depth knowledge and understanding of stress testing and scenario analysis methodologies and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in NG system preferred.
  • In-depth experience in quantitative risk modeling, calculation of Regulatory and Economic Capital.
  • Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.
  • Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth.

title: Director Data Analytics, Internal Audit
description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What you’ll be doing

As the leader of the Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) team within CIBC’s US Internal Audit function, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the vision for analytics-driven audit practices. Reporting to the Senior Director, Advanced Analytics & Data Management, you’ll guide a specialized team to design and deliver innovative analytics solutions, automated testing programs, and self-serve dashboards. You’ll partner closely with audit teams to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of audit activities through advanced analytics, machine learning, and Agentic AI. Your expertise will be critical in developing AI-powered use cases, such as continuous risk monitoring, automated issue tracking, intelligent sampling, and real-time audit insights. By fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, you’ll help drive the evolution of internal audit at CIBC.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You\'ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you\'ll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How you\'ll succeed

  • Advanced Analytics & Innovation – Lead the development and implementation of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions to support the US Internal Audit plan, including automated testing, continuous monitoring, and deep-dive analysis.

  • Stakeholder Engagement – Collaborate with Audit Portfolio Directors and business partners to identify analytics opportunities, prioritize engagements, and promote the adoption of data-driven audit techniques.

  • Team Leadership & Development – Provide strategic and motivational leadership to the analytics team, ensuring learning and growth opportunities, and supporting the professional development of team members.

  • Automation & Tool Development – Oversee the creation and maintenance of automated analytics tools and self-serve dashboards, and introduce new use cases for automation through collaboration with internal partners.

  • Training & Communication – Champion the use of advanced analytics across audit portfolios by delivering proof-of-concept engagements, demonstrations, and educational sessions.

  • Data Governance & Project Management – Ensure effective management of audit data, adherence to governance practices, and successful delivery of multiple concurrent analytics projects in a dynamic environment.

Who you are

  • You’re an analytics leader. You have significant experience in data analytics, quantitative modeling, business intelligence, or statistical analysis, with a Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Business. Certification and experience in machine learning and AI are strong assets.

  • You’re a problem solver. You thrive on investigating complex challenges, making sense of information, and communicating data-driven insights in a clear and impactful way.

  • You understand risk and controls. You’re knowledgeable about audit methodology and can advise on the design and execution of analytics engagements that provide assurance to the bank and audit committee. Audit certification or experience is an asset.

  • You have technical expertise. You’re proficient with data analysis tools, databases (such as Oracle and SQL Server), and open-source programming languages like Python. Experience with Azure Cloud, Power Platform, and Databricks is an advantage.

  • You’re a relationship builder. You excel at collaborating with stakeholders across all lines of defense and support functions, from peers to executives, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values—trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

  • We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

  • Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

  • We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

*Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
Finance • Multiple Locations (San Francisco, New York, Toronto) • Full time • Hybrid/Remote

Cohere is at the forefront of AI innovation, building cutting-edge language models and AI systems. Our Finance team plays a critical role in supporting our rapid growth and ensuring operational excellence. We value technical expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our financial infrastructure while working at the intersection of finance and transformative technology.

We are seeking a seasoned Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to provide strategic leadership for our financial reporting and technical accounting functions. This executive-level role requires a proven leader who can serve as the ultimate technical accounting authority while overseeing all aspects of SEC reporting and shaping the finance department’s strategic direction. You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with US GAAP and SEC regulations, establishing enterprise-wide accounting standards, and building world-class financial infrastructure. description:

Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Specialist, Cybersecurity (IAM) will be working in a fast paced and innovative environment for one of North America’s top airlines. Air Canada’s cyber security systems are foundational to protecting the data and systems that allow its customers to fly safely. Air Canada is making significant investments to enhance its Identity and Access Management (IAM) capabilities through process maturity, and technology enablement.

In this role, the IAM Specialist will support, administer, and continuously enhance Air Canada\'s Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities, with a primary focus on SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) as a cornerstone of the organization\'s security and access strategy. Success in this position requires close collaboration across multiple departments to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure IAM services that support Air Canada\'s enterprise environment and strengthen internal controls.

This position may be based in Toronto, Montreal, Calgary or Vancouver.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer, support and maintain Air Canada’s SailPoint IIQ platform and supporting infrastructure, ensuring stable, secure, and reliable operations across environments.
  • Oversee configuration and ongoing administration of SailPoint IIQ capabilities, including identity lifecycle management, provisioning/deprovisioning, access requests, access certifications, and segregation of duties controls.
  • Support and improve identity lifecycle management (joiner/mover/leaver), including authoritative source processing, downstream provisioning, and deprovisioning workflows to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM-related technical issues, including identity data problems, provisioning failures, connector/integration issues, workflow errors, and performance bottlenecks, and drive issues to resolution.
  • Analyze business processes and workflows, and recommend IAM solutions that promote enterprise security, operational efficiency, and improved user experience.
  • Participate and contribute to IAM projects and initiatives (e.g. IAM program).
  • Lead efforts to reduce and mitigate Air Canada IAM risks.
  • Create, support, and maintain IAM documentation (IAM processes, Standard Operating Procedures).
  • Enforce compliance of Air Canada IAM policy and procedures.
  • Develop, manage, measure and report on key service-level metrics showcasing the effectiveness of Air Canada’s IAM practice.
  • Define and maintain methods and techniques to improve IAM operational processes.
  • Be a senior technical resource and subject matter expert on matters related to IAM.
  • Build relationships throughout the organization to enhance and support our focus on safe, secure, and reliable operations.
  • Develop and communicate IAM objectives; inspire, motivate and train team members to follow and achieve organizational IAM standards.
  • Maintain up-to-date understanding of IAM processes, principles, best practices, and technologies, with a strong emphasis on SailPoint IIQ administration and enterprise IGA operations.
  • Stay current with IAM trends and advancements, participating in continuous improvement initiatives for the organization\'s identity governance program.

Qualifications

  • A relevant University degree/technical certification, and/or relevant experience commensurate to the role
  • 5+ years of experience supporting and maturing IAM solutions in large enterprise environments, with at least 3+ years of hands-on SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) administration experience (IIQ 8.x preferred).
  • Expertise in SailPoint IIQ concepts and operations, including directory services integration, identity aggregation and correlation concepts, lifecycle management, provisioning and deprovisioning, approval workflows, and access certifications
  • Expertise with RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) and SoD (Segregation of Duties) concepts.
  • Experience with enterprise directories and identity sources & targets (Active Directory, Entra ID)
  • Strong understanding of modern authentication and identity concepts (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SCIM, MFA, SSO).
  • Experience integrating or supporting integrations with cloud and hybrid environments (e.g., Azure/Entra ID, AWS).
  • Experience with programming and scripting used in IAM/IGA customization and automation such as Java, BeanShell, PowerShell, JavaScript, Python, C# and .NET
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns commonly used in enterprise IAM (REST/SOAP APIs, secure connectivity, certificates, and basic troubleshooting of integration endpoints).
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) administration and performance troubleshooting (database management concepts, SQL queries, stored procedures, runtime optimizations) in support of enterprise applications, including SailPoint IIQ.
  • Knowledge of compliance, audit, and risk principles relevant to IAM and Identity Governance, particularly in environments where access certifications and strong internal controls are required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively present information.
  • Demonstrated experience (5 years +): Incident/Major Incident, ITIL process concepts and execution (Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management)
  • In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity control frameworks (NIST, ISO, etc).
  • Demonstrated teamwork and leadership, with the ability to mentor junior staff and work effectively across technology and business teams.
  • Able to communicate effectively and to work collaboratively with all levels of the organization with superior verbal and written skills
  • Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and in rapidly changing environments or uncertain conditions.
  • Nice To have:
    • SailPoint professional certification.
    • Familiarity with DevOps pipelines and CI/CD best practices for IAM solution delivery.
    • Experience delivering IAM solutions in hybrid or cloud-native environments.
    • Experience supporting access certification programs in regulated environments, including preparation of audit evidence and support of control testing activities.

description:
Requisition ID: 263946

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Wealth Management Associate Program – MD Financial 

Start date: January 2027 

Work hours/week: 37.5 

Job locations: Edmonton, Alberta

Scotiabank is among the largest banks in the world and is Canada’s most international bank. We are powered by high-performing (and awesome) teammates who make a real difference across the globe as a leading provider of advice, products, digital experiences, and financial services in more than 50 countries. Together with our Digital Factories around the world, we are dedicated to helping over 25 million customers become better-off. 

At Scotiabank, you’ll grow your skills, be recognized for your contributions, and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are value and everyone can thrive.

MD Financial Management is a national wealth management firm dedicated exclusively to supporting Canada’s physicians and their families. With more than 50 years of physician‑focused experience, MD provides objective advice and comprehensive financial planning tailored to the unique needs of medical professionals, helping them manage, grow, and protect their wealth throughout every stage of their careers.

Is this program right for you?

There has never been a better time to join MD Financial Management as a Wealth Management Associate.

The Wealth Management Associate Program is a salaried development program aimed at developing sales and entrepreneurial-minded individuals into a Wealth Advisory role. The program offers a strong foundation in financial planning, relationship building, and client discovery- skills that are highly valued in Advisory careers. We welcome applicants from diverse academic and professional backgrounds who are eager to make a meaningful difference in clients’ lives.

Do you have the skills that will help you succeed? – We’d love to work with you if: 

  • You're completing an undergraduate or master’s degree by January 2027, or you are a recent graduate with less than 5 years of experience and have developed a passion for helping others achieve their financial goals.

  • You’re excited about building a long‑term career in Wealth Advisory

  • You’re naturally curious, thoughtful, and collaborative, and you enjoy solving problems that matter to people.

  • You’re adaptable, open to feedback, and motivated to grow.

  • You remain positive and resilient when faced with challenges.

  • You have strong communication and relationship management skills; the ability to build and maintain strong collaborative client and internal/ external partner relationships. 

  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

  • You’re entrepreneurial‑minded and energized by helping clients navigate important life decisions in a sales advisory capacity

  • You remain positive and resilient when faced with challenges.

  • You can demonstrate an ability to influence, persuade, and build consensus

  • You keep current on issues affecting the financial affairs of clients, including a general knowledge of income tax, investment trends and products, as well as any other issues impacting clients.

  • You are interested in client meeting preparation, drafting post meeting notes and identifying next opportunities, gathering and inputting financial data resulting from discovery conversations.

  • You are interested in the preparation of comprehensive financial plans and specific investment strategies based on MD Management developed and managed optimal portfolio ranges

Note: You do not need to meet 100% of these criteria to be a strong candidate. We encourage all interested applicants—from all communities—to apply.

What’s in it for you? 

  • A comprehensive training and development experience that provides a thorough understanding of Scotiabank’s Wealth Advisory businesses and Total Wealth Planning approach. Your growth is our top priority, and you will be supported through formal web‑based and in‑person training, on‑the‑job learning, educational speaker events, professional development opportunities, and ongoing mentorship throughout the program.

  • Opportunities within the Wealth Advisory businesses to gain exposure as to how these areas apply to an overall wealth strategy for a client’s life. 

  • Placement in a MD Financial Management office to work with wealth teams to gain relevant and practical experience, complementary training, and support to help prepare you to attain licensing requirements associated with transitioning into a Wealth Management Advisory role. 

  • Ongoing support during the Program through various touch points with the Program Lead, Total Wealth Planning leaders, and your local Manager. 

  • A compensation program with competitive salary, opportunities for annual performance incentives based on performance thresholds, a flexible benefits program, and continuing education programs. 

How do I apply? 

For candidates applying to our new graduate programs, we do not require resumes! We believe in evaluating you through relationships over resumes and are focused on learning about who you are and what you’re interested in to uncover your true potential. Instead, we ask that as part of your application you complete the below: 

  1. Complete your PLUM Profile here and save as a screenshot. 

  1. Complete a short one-way video interview here. 

  1. Apply to the role and when the application asks for your resume, instead upload the screenshot of your PLUM Profile. 

Location(s): Canada : Alberta : Edmonton

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. description:

The Position

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Positioned within our Data Management team, a core function of Product Development Data Sciences (PDD), you will help us lead the industry in speed, quality, and efficiency. By joining us, you step into an innovative environment where we build cutting-edge tools, automation, and next-generation technologies that streamline clinical trial data collection and delivery, accelerating the release of life-saving medicines to patients worldwide.

As a Senior Technical Specialist with a focus on Agentic AI, you will design and deploy autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems to transform how clinical trial data is processed. You will bridge the gap between state-of-the-art LLM orchestration and strict pharmaceutical regulatory standards, building systems that automate clinical data cleaning, validation, and analysis. This is your chance to shape a modern, scalable ecosystem where your engineering solutions directly drive GxP-compliant, high-impact clinical decisions.

The Opportunity:

  • Design and deploy sophisticated agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen to automate complex clinical data management tasks.

  • Build collaboration systems where specialised agents (e.g., Planner, Validator, and Protocol Reviewer) resolve end-to-end data challenges through high-quality, testable code and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Apply systematic prompt engineering techniques (including Chain-of-Thought, ReAct, and Reflection) to guarantee high-fidelity outputs in a clinical context.

  • Deploy AI agents into our cloud environment (AWS) while building and enhancing scalable applications that capture, move, and prepare scientific data.

  • Partner with Data Integrity and Quality teams to ensure all agentic decisions are traceable, reproducible, and fully compliant with regulatory standards.

  • Create reliable "Human-in-the-loop" (HITL) workflows and tool-calling agents to solve complex, highly regulated data challenges.

Who You Are:

You are a strategic, forward-thinking engineer who thrives at the intersection of full-stack engineering, advanced AI orchestration, and real-world scientific impact. You enjoy solving intricate technical challenges, value model reproducibility, and bring clear, collaborative communication to a global team.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

  • 5+ years’ experience and a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or Biomedical Informatics, alongside 8+ years of experience delivering AI/ML solutions plus 3+ years in full-stack software and data engineering.

  • Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex.

  • Solid experience with modern data engineering (SQL/NoSQL, APIs), Vector Databases (e.g., Chroma, Pinecone), and optimizing RAG pipelines.

  • Strong experience deploying AI systems on AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, Git, and service observability (logging, tracing, metrics).

  • A strong understanding of model reproducibility, interpretability, and validation best practices within highly regulated environments.

  • Excellent problem-solving capabilities with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse global stakeholders.

Preferred:

As a Lead Data Scientist on our Analytics and Data Insights team, you\'ll tackle problems that don\'t have textbook answers yet; shaping go-to-market strategy for technology that\'s still being invented, designing the experiments that prove or kill our biggest bets, and helping enterprises understand what foundational AI actually means for their bottom line.   • Drive the mission forward.

  • Own the science: design and lead experimentation programs including A/B tests, multi-armed bandits, causal inference studies, that directly map to product and go-to-market decisions.

  • Build predictive models that matter: develop and deploy models for forecasting, segmentation, propensity scoring, and opportunity sizing across Cohere\'s core business lines.

  • Shape strategy: partner across product, research, sales, and finance to define how Cohere grows. Your team\'s work will get built into products and implemented into strategy.

title: Director, AI Technology Delivery
description:
Application Deadline:

10/30/2026

Address:

250 Yonge Street

Job Family Group:

Data Analytics & Reporting

Hybrid Work Model

About the Role

As Director, Technology Delivery Lead, you are accountable for the end-to-end technology delivery of Em, BMO InvestorLine\'s premier AI agent. You will lead the integrated delivery system across AI engineering, wealth platforms, Microsoft Azure, data, architecture, quality engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and third parties to deliver safe, resilient, scalable, and measurable client outcomes.

You will operate as the principal technology counterpart to the Product Owner for Em. Together, you are jointly accountable for overall delivery: the Product Owner leads product vision, client value, priorities, and acceptance; the Technology Delivery Lead owns the integrated technology plan, engineering execution, technical quality, production readiness, and predictable delivery. This role is not a program coordination position. It is a hands-on senior technology leadership role with clear decision rights and accountability for outcomes.

Mandate and Decision Rights

  • Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
  • Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
  • Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
  • Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence-based release criteria.
  • Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Technology Delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
  • Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
  • Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
  • Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
  • Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.

2. AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership

  • Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
  • Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
  • Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
  • Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
  • Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.

3. Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration

  • Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
  • Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
  • Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
  • Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
  • Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.

4. Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery

  • Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
  • Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
  • Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
  • Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
  • Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.

5. Quality, Risk and Responsible AI

  • Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
  • Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
  • Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
  • Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.

6. Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
  • Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
  • Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
  • Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

  • Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
  • AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
  • Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
  • Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
  • Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
  • Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
  • Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
  • Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
  • Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

Qualifications and Experience

description:
Description

The Senior Manager, Portfolio Management & Program Delivery is a strategic leadership role within IT, Data & Digital (IDD), accountable for advancing technology portfolio management and enabling disciplined execution of complex programmes and projects. The role provides senior leadership with integrated, decision-oriented visibility across demand, investment, roadmaps, delivery performance, risks, dependencies, capacity and business outcomes.

Based on organisational priorities, the incumbent may lead a portfolio-management function, oversee a team of programme and project delivery professionals, personally lead one or more large strategic programmes, or assume a combination of these accountabilities.

Acting as a trusted advisor, integrator and people leader, the incumbent aligns technology investments and delivery priorities with branch objectives and measurable business value.

The role partners closely with senior stakeholders across IDD, Finance, Strategic Procurement and business branches and requires strong executive presence, sound judgement and the ability to influence across complex, cross-functional environments.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Portfolio & Investment Management

  • Lead and evolve portfolio-management practices in alignment with IDD strategy and the Product & Platform Operating Model.
  • Provide an integrated view of demand, investments, roadmaps, dependencies, delivery health, resource capacity and business outcomes across product, platform and engineering teams.
  • Shape decision-oriented insights that support prioritisation, sequencing, funding and trade-off decisions across competing initiatives.
  • Oversee demand intake and triage to promote transparency, consistent evaluation and alignment with strategic priorities and available capacity.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders on capital planning, forecasting, business cases, investment governance and benefits realisation.
  • Establish practical frameworks and guardrails that clarify when initiatives require programme-management support versus product-level execution.

Program & Project Delivery Leadership

  • Provide expert guidance and oversight throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring initiatives are well defined, properly planned and executed with discipline.
  • Based on assignment, personally lead one or more large, complex technology or transformation programmes, establishing governance and bringing business and technology leaders together to deliver expected outcomes.
  • Define fit-for-purpose project structures, delivery models, governance forums and team constructs, ensuring roles, accountabilities, decision rights and resourcing needs are clear from initiation through execution.
  • Support project budgeting and financial planning, including cost estimates, funding assumptions, resource forecasts, vendor spend and ongoing monitoring of budget performance against approved plans.
  • Lead and oversee programme managers, project managers, project analysts and other delivery professionals, providing direction, coaching and escalation support.
  • Provide hands-on oversight and advisory support to programme and project managers, including review of steering committee materials, executive updates, delivery plans, RAID logs and decision to ensure issues, risks and recommendations are clearly framed for leadership.
  • Participate in key governance forums, steering committees and executive readiness discussions as appropriate, providing independent delivery perspective, challenge and escalation support where required.
  • Establish clear success criteria, key performance indicators and delivery measures, and monitor progress against scope, schedule, budget, quality, value and outcome commitments.
  • Conduct risk assessments, identify interdependencies and constraints, and drive timely mitigation and escalation with accountable stakeholders.
  • Apply agile, waterfall and hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, while ensuring alignment with IDD standards and evolving ways of working.

Governance, Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide concise executive-level portfolio and programme reporting that highlights accomplishments, decisions required, risks, dependencies, financial performance and corrective actions.
  • Implement consistent governance, health checks, quality assurance and performance-management practices across assigned portfolios and programmes.
  • Drive the use of fit-for-purpose tools, dashboards and Jira-based reporting to improve visibility, data quality and decision-making.
  • Promote benefits realisation and value tracking so investments remain connected to expected business outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in portfolio and delivery processes, using metrics, feedback and lessons learned to improve predictability, speed and quality.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant regulatory, audit, security and compliance requirements and ensure they are incorporated into governance and execution.

Stakeholder, Financial & Partner Management

  • Build trusted, collaborative relationships with senior leaders, product and platform teams, engineering, Finance, Strategic Procurement, business partners and external vendors.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, programme sponsors and decision-making forums, translating complex information into clear choices and recommendations.
  • Facilitate alignment across teams where initiatives span multiple products, platforms, delivery organisations or investment horizons.
  • Support vendor governance and coordination to enable effective blended teams, clear accountability and high-quality outcomes.

People Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of approximately 4-6 portfolio, programme and/or project-management professionals, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performance environment.
  • Establish consistent methods, tools, expectations and ways of working while maintaining flexibility to meet the needs of different portfolios, products and programmes.
  • Build organisational capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, succession planning and targeted development of critical portfolio and delivery skills.
  • Promote a culture of curiosity, innovation, ownership, continuous improvement and outcome-focused execution.
  • Conduct regular performance and development discussions, provide constructive feedback and support career growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in business, technology, finance, engineering or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in technology transformation, portfolio management, enterprise programme delivery or related leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, cross-functional initiatives and/or portfolio-management functions in a dynamic organisation.
  • Strong portfolio and financial-management capability, including demand prioritisation, investment planning, business cases, forecasting, resource planning and benefits tracking.
  • Proven ability to establish and improve governance frameworks, delivery methodologies, management practices, reporting standards and reusable tools.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams and creating clarity in ambiguous or evolving operating environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder-management, facilitation and communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Working knowledge of agile, waterfall and hybrid delivery methods; PMP, Agile/Scrum, Prosci or equivalent certifications are assets.
  • Experience in the airline industry, technology vendor management or operating-model transformation is an asset.
  • Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

The Manager will ensure the completeness and accuracy of financial records for all investments and establish a close working relationship with other members within the Finance, Tax, Legal and Deal teams.
