title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer – OmniGTM.ai
Initiative: OmniGTM.ai
Position Type: Full-time
Location: Hybrid, on-site
About OmniGTM.ai
AEPG is building the AI-native Go-To-Market (GTM) platform designed to eliminate operational silos across marketing, sales, and customer success. The OmniGTM.ai platform brings CRM data, third-party enrichment, intent signals, user interactions, and activation workflows together into a single source of truth that organizations can trust.
Our customers are global B2B organizations that want to accelerate revenue, modernize GTM operations, and deploy AI responsibly at enterprise scale. As a foundational engineering hire, you will directly influence the architecture, data patterns, and infrastructure behind the next generation of GTM systems.

Job Summary
We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to design and operate the complete data foundation for OmniGTM.ai. You will lead the design and implementation of production-grade data pipelines using MongoDB Atlas, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, AWS services, Spark-based processing, and Delta Lake patterns. You will be responsible for creating robust data ingestion, transformation, lineage, governance, and real-time access layers that support predictive scoring, account intelligence, workflow automation, and advanced analytics.
This role demands deep expertise in pipeline engineering, schema evolution, distributed data processing, and cloud-native design. You will collaborate closely with AI engineers, solution architect, and product leadership to build data systems that are reliable, scalable, cost efficient, and optimized for AI workloads.

Key Responsibilities
Pipeline and Architecture

  • Design and operate high-throughput ETL and ELT pipelines that process CRM data, enrichment provider data, and user interaction signals.
  • Build distributed processing workflows using PySpark, AWS EMR, and Delta Lake formats.
  • Create resilient ingestion and transformation patterns using Python, Spark, Airflow or an equivalent orchestrator, and AWS-native services.

Unified Data Foundation and Schema Evolution

  • Own schema design for MongoDB Atlas and Aurora PostgreSQL supporting flexible, relational, and AI enriched data.
  • Implement schema evolution practices including versioning, backward compatibility, automated validation, and structured data contracts.
  • Maintain the unified GTM data model.

AI and Machine Learning Enablement

  • Build infrastructure to support feature engineering, training dataset generation, and real-time inference.
  • Provide AI teams with optimized data pipelines that ensure quality, explainability, and low latency.

Governance, Observability, and Optimization

  • Implement data governance, lineage, and quality frameworks for security, compliance, and accuracy.
  • Monitor pipelines and storage performance using CloudWatch, X-Ray, metrics, alerts, and operational dashboards.
  • Continuously optimize query performance, storage layout, and job execution costs across Spark, EMR, Aurora, and S3.

Collaboration and Leadership

  • Partner with architects, product managers, and GTM strategists to align data systems with business workflows.
  • Mentor engineers on modern data engineering practices, distributed processing, and cloud-native design.
  • Influence technical direction, architecture decisions, and long-term platform strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Seven or more years of Data Engineering experience building and operating production-scale pipelines.
  • Strong Python programming with experience in building services, automation, and data workflows.
  • Proficiency in PySpark and distributed data processing patterns.
  • Experience with AWS EMR, Delta Lake, and Spark based data lakes.
  • Expert SQL skills and proficiency with relational systems, preferably Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL and ELT orchestration tools such as Airflow or AWS Glue.
  • Depth in AWS services including S3, Lambda, IAM, Kinesis, and Glue.
  • Experience with NoSQL environments such as MongoDB Atlas or DynamoDB.
  • Strong understanding of schema design, schema evolution, data modeling, and governance frameworks.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AI or ML pipelines, feature stores, or MLOps tooling including SageMaker.
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or AWS CDK.
  • Understanding of GDPR, SOC2, ISO27001, or other compliance standards.
  • Background in B2B data, GTM workflows, or sales and marketing analytics.


Why Join OmniGTM.ai

  • Shape the core data architecture of an AI-native GTM platform designed for enterprise scale and predictive intelligence.
  • Solve complex, high-impact data challenges spanning CRM pipelines, enrichment ecosystems, intent data, and AI orchestration.
  • Collaborate with senior AI engineers, platform architects, and product leaders who are redefining how modern GTM teams operate.
  • Own critical architectural decisions across pipelines, schemas, storage, governance, and distributed processing.
  • Earn competitive compensation and equity participation in an ambitious and rapidly growing AI venture.
  • Build data systems that will influence how the next generation of B2B companies activate and scale revenue.


How to Apply
Send your resume and a brief cover letter outlining relevant experience to sara@aepg.ca with the subject line Senior Data Engineer – OmniGTM.ai.

OmniGTM.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

  • Architect the scheduling and orchestration of containerized large-scale inference deployments on GPU clusters across clouds.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++; experience with Go or Rust is a plus; solid CS fundamentals: algorithms & data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, parallel programming, distributed systems, deep learning theories.

  • Knowledgeable and passionate about performance engineering in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM and SGLang).

  • Familiarity with GPU programming and performance: CUDA, memory hierarchy, streams, NCCL; proficiency with profiling/debug tools (e.g., Nsight Systems/Compute).

  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Slurm); familiarity with Linux namespaces and cgroups.

  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills; ability to excel in a fast-paced, multi-functional setting.

title: Technical Program Manager, Product Engineering
description:
Who are we?

Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers.

Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products.

Join us on our mission and shape the future!

Position Overview

Our platform is expanding beyond a single product into a portfolio of new AI-powered product experiences. This is an early-stage, high-visibility program with multiple workstreams in flight.We\'re looking for an EPM to be the operating backbone of this program. You\'ll report into our Product Engineering function. This is not a delivery coordination role; it\'s a program architecture role. You\'ll build the structure, rhythms, and visibility mechanisms that let multiple product teams and their cross-functional partners execute with clarity.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will:

  • Own cross-team program coordination, tracking progress, dependencies, and risks across all workstreams and their functional components (Product, Design, Engineering, Finance, Revenue) simultaneously

  • Drive the executive operating cadence, synthesising status into clear signal and surfacing risks before they become blockers

  • Build the program infrastructure from scratch: roadmapping templates, status reporting, milestone tracking, and cross-team dependency mapping, across a program that is nascent and evolving

  • Coordinate shared resources (particularly MLE and PD capacity) across teams, identifying scheduling conflicts and driving prioritisation decisions with the relevant leads

  • Support each team lead in standing up their weekly team cadence and holding the standard for how progress is communicated upward

  • Operate across function and build credibility and influence with stakeholders who don\'t report into your org.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 4+ years as an Engineering or Technical Program Manager, with at least some of that time spent at a startup or high-growth company where you built programs rather than inherited them

  • Demonstrated experience running multiple simultaneous workstreams. You can hold a complex picture in your head, spot cascading risks early, and keep several parallel programs moving without losing the thread

  • Strong executive communication: you know how to distil messy, multi-team status into crisp, decision-ready updates for senior leadership, and you know when to escalate versus resolve

  • Fluency with AI/ML product development

  • A builder\'s instinct: comfortable in ambiguous, low-structure environments where you\'re creating the process, not following it, and pragmatic enough to ship something imperfect rather than wait for perfect

  • Cross-functional influence without authority: you\'ve worked in roles where you had to align Finance, GTM, and engineering leads who all had different priorities, and you know how to move people without a mandate

  • Experience working with or alongside technical leads: you can have a credible conversation about technical dependencies and constraints without needing things translated.

Bonus experience

  • Building OKR or roadmapping systems from scratch in a scaling org

  • Prior work inside an AI or LLM product company.

If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🧑‍💻 Work closely with a team on the cutting edge of AI research

🍽 Weekly lunch stipend, in-office lunches & snacks

🦷 Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget to take care of your mental health

🐣 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months

🎨 Personal enrichment benefits towards arts and culture, fitness and well-being, quality time, and workspace improvement

🏙 Remote-flexible, offices in Toronto, New York, San Francisco, London and Paris, as well as a co-working stipend

✈️ 6 weeks of vacation (30 working days!)

  • Evaluate the model’s ability to respond to objective financial queries ( you will not be giving financial advice)

  • Label, proofread, and improve machine-written and human-written financial outputs.

  • Follow our style guide, and make recommendations on unique situations that fall outside of its scope.

  • Evaluating financial models in excel.

Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples.
Multiple Choice Finance Test - A multiple choice test assessing your financial knowledge.
Finance/Investment Analysis Written Test - This online test will assess your financial/investment analysis skillset, through written and more in-depth questions.
Video Interview - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team!

Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. We’re a small, diverse team working at the cutting edge of machine learning. At Cohere, our mission is to build machines that understand the world and to make them safely accessible to all. Language is at the crux of this, but it can be difficult and expensive to parse the syntax, semantics, and context that all work together to give words meaning. The Cohere platform provides access to Large Language Models through its APIs that read billions of web pages and learn to understand the meaning, sentiment, and intent of the words we use in a richness never seen before.

We recently raised our Series B, signed a multi-year partnership with Google Cloud, and we are focused on bringing our technology to market. We will partner with customers so they can build natural language understanding and generation into their products with just a few lines of code.

We’re ambitious — we believe our technology will fundamentally transform how industries interact with natural language. Our entire technical team is world-class.

We are focused on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment so that all of our team members can thrive. We welcome kind and brilliant people to our team, from wherever they come.

Distribute and optimize anything and everything.

If you are an experienced software engineer aiming to break into the ML industry, this is the role you are looking for!

Please Note: We have offices in Toronto, Palo Alto, and London but embrace being remote-first! There are no restrictions on where you can be located for this role.

    • Build and test the scalable services in the framework using cutting-edge distributed frameworks

title: Software Engineer, ML Frameworks
description:
Who are we?
We’re a small, diverse team working at the cutting edge of machine learning. At Cohere, our mission is to build machines that understand the world and to make them safely accessible to all. Language is at the crux of this, but it can be difficult and expensive to parse the syntax, semantics, and context that all work together to give words meaning. The Cohere platform provides access to Large Language Models through its APIs that read billions of web pages and learn to understand the meaning, sentiment, and intent of the words we use in a richness never seen before.

We recently raised our Series B, signed a multi-year partnership with Google Cloud, and we are focused on bringing our technology to market. We will partner with customers so they can build natural language understanding and generation into their products with just a few lines of code.

We’re ambitious — we believe our technology will fundamentally transform how industries interact with natural language. And we have the technical chops to back it up - Cohere’s CEO, Aidan Gomez, is a co-author of the groundbreaking paper “Attention is all you need”, (over 23k citations) and was previously part of Google Brain. Our entire technical team is world-class.

We are focused on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment so that all of our team members can thrive. We welcome kind and brilliant people to our team, from wherever they come.

Why this role?
Distribute and optimize anything and everything.

This role is ideal for you if you are excited about building a scale-first machine learning framework that powers Cohere’s language models. Here you will design and improve upon the framework that enables fast, reliable, and flexible training of large language models. In this role, you will work on the cutting edge of research and engineering, design and develop state-of-the-art machine learning models. If you are an experienced software engineer aiming to break into the ML industry, this is the role you are looking for!

Please Note: We have offices in Toronto, Palo Alto, and London but embrace being remote-first! There are no restrictions on where you can be located for this role.

As a Software Engineer - ML Frameworks, you will:

    • Design and improve upon the internal framework to train models
    • Build and test the scalable services in the framework using cutting-edge distributed frameworks
    • Build internal tooling (CI/CD, dev utilities) to move faster together
    • Keep up with the cutting edge and adopt new technologies to improve performance and reliability

You may be a good fit if:

    • You are familiar with distributed systems - Ray and multiprocessing
    • You are excited to add new technologies to your toolbox and use them where it makes sense
    • You are competent at Docker and Kubernetes
    • Bonus: You have experience with high-performance, large-scale compute systems
    • Bonus: You have worked with major ML frameworks - JAX, Tensorflow, Pytorch
If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you.

We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all.

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment
🧑‍💻 Work closely with a team on the cutting edge of AI research

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:

You’ll engage directly with Product Owners and other subject matter experts, to elicit business requirements, use standard templates to document key requirements and key business knowledge, business processes, and engage with team members to identify the highest value change.   • Established background in an Agile environment with a proven understanding of the software development life cycle.

Job Description:

Role Summary

Are you a passionate analytics professional looking to leverage your talents to improve the client experience at a major Canadian company? Do you love matching front end to back end data to understand client journeys and what behaviours lead to what outcomes? If so, Sun Life is looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Client Experience Insights and this might be the next role to develop your analytics career.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science and Analytics, Client Experience Insights and with a dotted line relationship to the newly created Director, CX Insights & Measurement role, the Senior Data Analyst will support the CX strategy and design teams in their journeys to become more data savvy. The role will focus on leveraging integrated data from various sources to help stakeholders make key decisions, drive client-centric value and increase our client index scores. You will help the team by, but not limited to, mining data for business insights, analyzing and interpreting trends using statistical tools and techniques, reporting on business performance and merging front end survey and web data to back end sales data.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

  • Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.
  • Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.
  • A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers, they solve the problem.
  • Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong SAS or Python skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?

  • Support analytic work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations in order to solve business problems. Be the analytic resource for the CX strategy and design teams
  • Deliver reports that are easy to interpret and rich with information
  • Merge front end survey and web analytics data with back end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
  • Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
  • Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
  • Automate recurring tasks to free up capacity. Find efficient ways of working
  • Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities
  • An active contributing member to the analytics academy to help foster and grow the data science community at Sun Life

What will you need to succeed?

  • 5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
  • Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
  • Expert using SAS or Python to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
  • Experience with Adobe analytics, or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
  • An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
  • Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
  • Ability to document work
  • BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)

What will be nice to have?

  • Past experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
  • Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
  • MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
  • Experience working with unstructured data
  • Big Data Technologies: Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, HBase, Storm, Spark, Kafka, etc.

Unique Requirements

The candidate selected for this role is required to have special clearance from the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. To see if you are eligible for this clearance, please review the section 201 on the Federal Government site (http://iss-ssi.pwgsc-tpsgc.gc.ca/msi-ism/ch2-prt1-eng.html) ​

What is in it for you?

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
  • Entitlement to flexible benefits, pension, stocks, savings and 4 weeks vacation
  • A friendly, collaborative and inclusive culture
  • Being part of our Analytics community, where we share best practices and broaden skill-sets

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

title: Software Engineer - ML/DevOps

title: Post Doctoral Fellow - General Medicine INpatient Initiative (GEMINI)
description:
GEMINI is a hospital data and analytics collaborative based out of Unity Health Toronto. GEMINI collects routinely-generated clinical and administrative data from hospital information systems, and has developed an infrastructure for data cleaning, standardization and analysis supporting research and quality improvement efforts.

Initially established as a collaboration between seven University of Toronto affiliated hospitals, GEMINI is growing in 2021 to a network of 30+ hospitals across Ontario. We are creating the biggest clinical data platform, the first of its kind in Canada, holding data on millions of patient hospitalizations that will cover ~60% of all medical and ICU patients in the province. Our research interests, and those of our partners, primarily span across the following categories: a) clinical epidemiology, to better understand patient cohorts and prevalence of diseases; b) health services research, to measure processes of care, delivery of care, and resource utilization; and c) predictive analytics, through artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methods to improve prediction of disease states, patient outcomes, and data processing. Additionally, data linkage work with the Institute of Clinical and Evaluative Sciences (ICES) is underway to investigate out-of-hospital risk factors and outcomes.

Recent GEMINI publications include 1) Descriptions of COVID-19 hospitalizations, care and outcomes (Verma et al., 2021 CMAJ) and 2) A framework for variation in physician practice patterns (Verma et al., 2020 BMJ Quality and Safety). GEMINI’s data applications also support quality improvement efforts, which formed the basis of the Ontario General Medicine Quality Improvement Network (GeMQIN). For more information, please visit geminimedicine.ca.

We are seeking a recent PhD graduate with excellent analytical skills to study hospital care, resource use, and clinical outcomes related to COVID-19. Supervised by GEMINI’s Co-Principal Investigators, the successful candidate will provide mentorship to graduate students and assist with preparation of research for publication and dissemination. Strong interpersonal and communication skills will be important assets for this role.

Responsibilities and Activities:

Research (85%):

In addition to conducting your own research with GEMINI data, you will be responsible for the following:

  • Initiate new research projects, including planning and coordination, statistical analysis, and interpretation of study results
  • Prepare protocols, project proposals, and research ethics board applications
  • Write, prepare, and format manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals in consultation with Co-Principal Investigators, the GEMINI team, and other research collaborators
  • Conduct quantitative data analysis, where appropriate, and coordinate analyses with other external organizations
  • Prepare datasets including calculating derived variables
  • Conduct literature reviews and other background research for publications
  • Revise manuscript drafts in response to reviewer and editor comments
  • Assist/lead in the writing and submission of grant applications

Managerial (15%):

  • Initiate new research projects, including the development of research proposals and protocols
  • Support the training and supervision of students
  • Develop budgets

Qualifications:

  • PhD in Biostatistics/Epidemiology, Applied Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or similar quantitatively-rigorous discipline
  • Advanced knowledge in inferential statistics and data science, knowledge in clinical research/internal medicine is preferred
  • Experience working with large administrative and clinical datasets
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a timely manner
  • Flexibility to adapt to a changing workload
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

We are looking for a savvy Data Engineer to join our growing team of analytics experts. The ideal candidate is an experienced data pipeline builder and data wrangler who enjoys optimizing data systems and building them from the ground up.   • Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader.
  • Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.

  • Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.

    • Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools: Azkaban, Luigi, Airflow, etc.
    • Experience with AWS cloud services: EC2, EMR, RDS, Redshift
    • Experience with stream-processing systems: Storm, Spark-Streaming, etc.
    • Experience with object-oriented/object function scripting languages: Python, Java, C++, Scala, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • General understand Roche Operating Principles and business processes.

Technical

Our AI Accelerator team plays a central role in harnessing the full potential of AI across the company. We act as transformation consultants to help our business unit partners create exponential value through an insight-by-design approach.

As a Manager of Artificial Intelligence, you will lead a team of 10 AI experts dedicated to the telecommunication technologies portfolio. What you bring

  • AI Expertise: Deep technical knowledge and 3+ years of experience in deploying AI and machine learning solutions, with a focus on telecommunication applications

  • Impactful communication: Ability to serve as the primary communication link and provide executive updates on cross-TELUS AI programs

  • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, Data Visualization, UX/UI
  • Strong knowledge of Agile or other lean methodologies
  • Strong knowledge of design, development, and implementation experience utilizing data technologies
  • Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong data profiling, cleaning, and mining
  • Ability to perform complex data analysis on large volumes of data and present findings to stakeholders
  • Expert data extract, transform, and load processes with a variety of data types
  • 2+ years of experience with big data technologies – Hadoop (Pig, Hive), noSQL/SQL databases, parallel processing techniques and Apache Spark
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: Ability to explain complex Audit and Technological concepts to various stakeholders ranging from Specialists to Executives

title: French Data Analysis and Prompt Engineering for Clinical AI Scribe
description:
About the company:

AutoScribe is an AI medical scribe, which uses speech recognition to transcribe a doctor-patient conversation, and then an LLM to generate a draft clinical note, which the clinician can then edit and save. This helps to save valuable documentation time for clinicians and allow them to focus on the patient during the visit instead of taking notes.

The medical domain is unique in that the formatting and details of the generated text are very important, as is the accuracy. This makes text generation more challenging than other use cases, but also creates a significant real-world impact. AutoScribe has hundreds of users in multiple countries, and we currently support note generation in English and French, and speech recognition in a number of languages. We have a growing number of French-speaking users and would like to improve our pipeline for French data.

AutoScribe is a product of Mutuo Health Solutions, a FastLane company

About the role:

2-3 month contract, remote (Ideally starting January 2026)

We are looking for a graduate student in natural language processing or computational linguistics who is a fluent (preferably native) speaker of French, to analyze clinical transcripts and AI-generated notes in French and make improvements to the prompts and data processing pipeline. If it aligns with the candidate’s skills, we would also like to explore hallucination detection improvements for French and possibly speaker labeling in the French transcripts.

The company will provide access to the data, relevant code, LLM models, and cloud computing. You will collaborate remotely with the AI team and French business liaisons.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze clinical data in Canadian French for hallucinations, formatting, and other text generation errors
  • Analyze text generation pipeline and prompts and make improvements to correct errors
  • Test existing speech recognition pipeline for French data and evaluate different providers, work to improve medical term recognition in French
  • Communicate with our Quebec business liaison about French improvements

Requirements:

  • Native or bilingual French speaker, and working proficiency in English
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar field
  • Master’s or PhD completed or in progress in machine learning, NLP, AI, or similar field
  • Proficiency programming in Python
  • Experience with Github
  • Experience with OpenAI and other LLM APIs

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with medical data
  • Computational linguistics, NLP, or linguistics background
  • Experience with Linux command line, Jupyter notebooks, and Docker

title: Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary:

If you’re an experienced data analyst who can lead large-scale analytics projects and is ready to deliver valuable business insights through data-driven storytelling while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, this could be the right job for you.

Thomson Reuters is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to lead product analytics for CoCounsel for Tax, Accounting & Audit (Materia) – an agentic AI solution for the tax, audit, and accounting profession. CoCounsel for TAA is at the forefront of TR’s evolution towards AI-powered products, and this job is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to be involved in building products that will shape the future of the Tax profession. This role is part of the Thomson Reuters Product Analytics team, a group of approximately 25+ analysts of varied backgrounds who share ideas, best practices, and learnings with each other.

The Senior Analyst will be responsible for end-to-end product analytics for CoCounsel for TAA. They will work as an extension of the product team and will proactively collaborate closely with product, marketing, and design teams to support upcoming decisions and long-term goals. The senior analyst will own the implementation of product analytics trackers such as (not limited to) Pendo, conducting regular analysis, building reports/dashboards, and using them to produce feature/usage insights to drive product decisions. This product-focused role will require a thorough understanding and ownership of the assigned product, the roadmap, and skills to draw business, customer, and product insights from data. This is an ideal role for a product or business analyst who is great with data, has some experience with stakeholders and analytics initiatives, and is ready to take the next step in their career.

About the Role:

In this opportunity as a Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics, you will be responsible for:

  • Analytical Tools Implementation: Partner with developers/platform architects to deploy relevant product analytics solutions (like Pendo) and ensure the right metrics, journeys, and events are captured in-product

  • Data-Driven Decision Making Use product analytics/data to recognize patterns and trends to understand user behavior and identify improvement opportunities

  • Measurement Frameworks: Proactively establish measurement frameworks/success metrics for new product launches/ features and drive actionability through data-driven insights.

  • Stakeholder Management: Independently develop and manage relationships with peers/product managers/senior leadership for your portfolio ensuring collaborative partnership for OKR setting and driving analytical insights.

  • Center of Excellence: Partner with product teams to define and maintain support processes and inoculate a data-driven culture within the organization.

  • BI/Reporting: Partner with BI teams and other analysts to build dashboards and reports, including baselines and trends for page performance, feature usage, and customer segments

  • Thought Leadership: Demonstrate thought leadership by proactively leveraging analyses to understand products, derive insights, run experiments, and be the contact point for any analytics need for your portfolio.

  • Teamwork: Support peers (including data analysts) in their defined roles mentoring them with the best practices and providing recommendations for their analysis

About You:

You\'re a fit for the role of Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics if your background includes:

  • 5+ years of hands-on product analytics experience that includes some experience planning analytics measurement, working with stakeholders, and influencing specific decisions, OKRs, or metrics.

  • 5+ years of experience independently driving data-driven decision-making within product teams going beyond report generation to deliver insights through data storytelling. Experience with analyses such as customer journey mapping, audience profiling/segmentation, cohort analysis, tag management, and A/B testing.

  • 4+ years of experience using SQL; building and documenting queries for consistent team use.

  • 4+ years of experience with dashboarding techniques to make complex data more understandable and insightful using tools such as Tableau and PowerBI.

  • Demonstrated experience using statistical packages within Python/R to analyze structured and unstructured datasets and deliver insights on product usage and performance.

  • Strong communication skills, including experience in supporting and communicating data-driven analyses to various departments and stakeholders.

  • Exposure to product analytics tools such as Pendo, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics, and Google Analytics is an asset.

  • Building and maintaining support processes e.g. MS Azure Dev Ops, and MS SharePoint experience is an asset.

  • SAAS experience is an asset.

Join us to inform the way forward with the latest AI solutions and address real-world challenges in legal, tax, compliance, and news. Backed by our commitment to continuous learning and market-leading benefits, you’ll be prepared to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. This includes:

Our skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

The Compliance and EAML Examinations Program (CEEP) is a global examinations team, that carries out Regulatory Compliance and ML/TF Examinations of LOBs and functional groups.

The role operates under the Centralized Support Services (CSS) Team. CSS is responsible for supporting the EAML and Compliance Examination teams through the development, implementation and maintenance of the examination program, tools/templates, annual examination planning, training and management reporting. This program will enhance regulatory oversight by providing agile, real-time monitoring of key entity risk, complementing periodic examination testing for a more proactive and data-driven approach.

The continuous monitoring program will deliver valuable risk and control insights to CEEP examination teams, enhancing their ability to shape examination scope, make informed decisions, improve efficiency and respond swiftly to emerging regulatory risks.

You will collaborate with CEEP examination, methodology and quality assurance teams to develop data analytics guidance and tools to enhance testing coverage (e.g. 100% population testing), improve productivity and efficiency, and enable data-driven decision making for greater impact.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, and defence organizations. Technical Delivery & Execution:

  • Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

  • Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience as an Technical or Engineering Program Manager

  • At least 2 years in customer-facing technical delivery and operations for enterprise-grade software or AI/ML solutions

  • Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors)

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

Technical Background:

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

  • Knowledge of or experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, or deployment would be a strong differentiator

  • Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

  • Deep understanding of how government organizations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

  • Familiarity with Canadian government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

  • Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

  • Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

  • Eligible to obtain Canadian government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:

  • Active Canadian government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - strong preference for active Top Secret clearance

  • Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

  • Background in or strong familiarity with Canadian defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

  • Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

  • Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for Canadian government security clearance.

Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:

  • Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

  • Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

  • Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

SENIOR ML SPECIALIST - Software Development

ABOUT AI ENGINEERING @ VECTOR

Vector’s AI Engineering team enables researchers and partners in industry, health, and government to accelerate AI deployments that have the potential to unlock transformative benefits. Vector’s growing team of applied machine learning experts provide guidance, expertise, and tailored software tools to support Vector’s partners in collaborative projects through their robust technological and deep learning expertise and extensive compute capacity. AI infrastructure and engineering expertise housed in the AI Engineering team enables world-leading Vector-affiliated researchers to conduct and advance their experiments, pushing the frontiers of AI innovation.

If you are passionate about packaging machine learning models and pipelines into reusable software artifacts and have a strong background in software development, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and play a key role in advancing our software applications by leveraging the power of machine learning in a practical and scalable manner.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Applied ML Specialist to join our AI Engineering team. As a Senior Applied ML Specialist, your primary focus will be on packaging machine learning research into reusable software artifacts. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including researchers, software engineering, and product managers, to design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions that can be integrated seamlessly into our software applications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Applied ML Scientists, ML researchers, and other Applied ML Specialists to understand and package machine learning research into reusable software components.
  • Design and develop software libraries, modules, and APIs that encapsulate machine learning models, algorithms, and data preprocessing techniques.
  • Develop software frameworks and tools to streamline the integration and deployment of machine learning solutions in our software applications.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to identify ML opportunities and prioritize research areas for software integration.
  • Ensure the scalability, performance, and reliability of machine learning software artifacts through efficient code design, optimization, and testing.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning research and methodologies, and identify opportunities for leveraging new techniques.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure high code quality and adherence to best practices.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate machine learning software components into existing and new software applications.
  • Develop and maintain documentation and examples to support the adoption and usage of machine learning software artifacts by other developers.
  • Stay informed about data privacy and security regulations to ensure compliance in the development and deployment of machine learning solutions.

Success Measures:

  • The code quality and extensibility of existing libraries as well as new libraries implemented by AI Engineering is high. Systems design approach applied to development of new software;
  • The software and APIs developed by AI Engineering are well documented and there is strong user engagement, measured in terms of forks, PRs, issues and stars;
  • The number of successful products/models delivered by AI Engineering increases, where code is reused and duplicate effort is reduced. The number of APIs scaled to multiple users increases;
  • Software development and system design best practices are more widely adopted across the team, showcased by successful implementations, reliability, observability and operability;
  • A high degree of automation of code review and software continuous integration process is achieved. Automation of running of data pipelines, model training and evaluation using workflow orchestration tools is achieved; and,
  • Knowledge on software and systems design is shared across team, institutional knowledge on building responsible ML systems developed.

Profile of the Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus. 5-7 years of relevant industry experience in machine learning, software development, or a related field is required for this position.
  • Proven experience in packaging machine learning research into reusable software artifacts, with a focus on software development.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or C++, and experience with software development frameworks and tools.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling, and data preprocessing techniques.
  • Familiarity with popular machine learning libraries and frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX.
  • Experience in designing and developing software libraries, APIs, and frameworks for machine learning solutions.
  • Proficiency in software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and code documentation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate research ideas into practical and reusable software components.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.

This is an opportunity to join a forward-looking team to progress a digital transformation that will enable OMERS Capital Markets businesses and supporting functions to deliver on our pension promise. Monitor international financial markets/events, identify new trends and summarize new regulatory requirements.

Responding to Requests/Events: Facilitate effective risk-reward decisions by providing a separate opinion on business initiatives, including calibrating risk limits in alignment with the Bank's risk appetite framework.

Valuation: Ensure portfolios are accurately valued through analysis of daily P&L results and oversight over Separate Price Verification process.

Communication: Distilling relevant daily risk/market information into highlights, ensuring material issues are informed to stakeholders.

Advise and assist International Subsidiaries in the development of their risk management framework in line with the Bank’s standards for balance sheet management (e.g., Static Interest Rate Gaps, Net Interest Income, Economic Value, duration gap.), liquidity risk management (e.g., Liquidity Cash Gap, Liquidity Buffer, Liquidity Stress Testing) and market risk management (VaR, sVaR, Interest Rate Sensitivity (DV01)).

Conceptualize, develop, and deploy value-added analytical tools and data visualization solutions to assist treasury activities around structural interest rate risk and liquidity management. Develop and maintain tools and processes to eliminate manual tasks with automation.

  • Given the high volume of activity, the manager must be able to prioritize ongoing initiatives and efficiently multi-task to meet objectives. Ability to adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment is a must.

description:

title: Risk Management Quantitative Associate Rotational Program
description:
Campus Role Type

MBA and Advanced Degrees

Start Date

Winter, Summer

Hours

37.5

Department Overview

Risk Management at TD Bank Group (TD) is the bridge between computational analysis and business best practices. Quantitative assessments play a key function within TD; these are actively used for developing, validating and managing models for risk, pricing, hedging and capital evaluation of the various portfolios and financial products of TD. In other words, it’s all about the numbers.

Our enterprise has seen strong growth in its quantitative departments over recent years, reflecting improvements to computational ability, data quality and volume, along with the banking industry’s increasing attention to understanding and managing model risk. Our department is a global function that partners with all lines of businesses within TD, touching over 1,800 employees in offices across the globe: Canada, United States, the UK and Singapore. We also work externally with regulators and industry groups to align with industry standards, and we benchmark ourselves against best practices.

Job Details

About the Program
Through executive mentorship, the Risk Management Quantitative Associate Rotational Program is an immersive 24-month program designed to provide qualified and ambitious candidates the opportunity to step into our world. You’ll receive comprehensive experience developing, validating, implementing and managing quantitative models throughout the enterprise. The goal of the program is to develop candidates with the necessary experience and tools to become effective leaders within Risk Management.

If you have a sharp mathematical mind with an eye for finance, we want you to be part of our leadership rotational program.

In this program you’ll rotate across various quantitative departments within Risk Management areas every six months:

  • Model Development
  • Model Validation
  • Treasury and Balance Sheet Management
  • TD Insurance
  • TD Asset Management
  • TD Economics
  • Internal Audit

We align rotation opportunities with our business strategies to ensure you work on the most important priorities.

What You’ll Do
No matter where you work at TD you’ll make a meaningful impact, grow your skills and thrive in our culture of care. Here’s what that means for each rotation in our program:

Make an Impact:

  • Build mathematical and statistical models for the North American profile of TD, both US and Canada. These models include credit risk (e.g., Probability of Default, Exposure at Default and Loss Given Default), operational risk and market risk models used for risk management, accounting, economic/regulatory capital and stress testing purposes
  • Assist in the development and testing of new modelling methodologies and effectively challenge these models through benchmark modelling, model validation and/or review within Internal Audit’s model risk division
  • Prepare management summaries describing the mathematical analytics of models, validation techniques, test results and model limitations, including recommendations for further improvements
  • Help to manage the areas of risk and solvency assessment (ORSA), expected credit losses, asset and liability management along with liquidity
  • Participate in quantitative and qualitative validation efforts surrounding key processes including Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP), stress testing (DFAST/CCAR/EWST) and regulatory capital

Experience Growth:

  • Liaise with other business partners to ensure timely delivery of new models and resolve modelling issues
  • Demonstrate governance, control and risk management in alignment with TD policies and practices
  • Work on challenging projects alongside experienced leaders in the field

Cultivate our Culture of Care:

  • Develop strong relationships to help identify collaborative opportunities and coordinating efforts with other Risk groups
  • Be supported by a robust team of colleagues, peers and advisors to ensure your growth, development and success

Colleague Development
If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. Receive regular career, development and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. Whether you have a passion for helping customers and want to expand your experience, or you want to coach and inspire your colleagues, there are many different career paths within our organization at TD – and we’re committed to helping you identify opportunities that support your goals.

Job Requirements

What You Need to Succeed
We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Strong quantitative background with advanced mathematical and/or statistical ability
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Computational and programming skills (e.g., R, Python, SAS, Matlab, C++, C, among others)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; can explain complex technical issues in everyday language
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to work independently when required
  • Fast learner who grasps new concepts and techniques quickly
  • Desire to work in a caring, respectful and inclusive environment where all employees are supported

Additional Information

Educational Requirements

  • Graduated between May 2022 and May 2024 with a graduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, physics, engineering, or similar
  • Candidates pursuing a graduate degree must have completed all requirements (courses, projects, exams, etc.) for the graduate degree prior to start (excluding convocation)

Program Location and Start Date
This is a Toronto-based program which starts in January 2024 or July 2024.

Applications must include:

  1. Transcript
  2. Cover letter (one letter-sized page or less). If you are pursuing a graduate degree, please include graduation month/date/year in your cover letter
  3. Resume (two letter-sized pages only)

Posting Close Date: September 22nd 2023

We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. We thank all applicants for their interest!

Company Overview

Our Values
At TD we’re guided by our purpose is to enrich the lives of our customers, communities and colleagues, and share a set of values that shape our culture and guide our behavior. In exchange for how our colleagues show up to help TD succeed, we are committed to delivering a colleague experience grounded in Impact, Growth and a Culture of Care. No matter where you work across TD, we empower you to make an impact at work and in your community, explore and grow your career and be part of our caring and inclusive culture.

Making Your Well-being a Priority
A caring and supportive culture that promotes colleague well-being is core to who we are. At TD, we focus on total well-being with extensive programs to help colleagues assess, manage, and improve their well-being across four core pillars — physical, financial, social and mental/emotional. In addition, we champion a safe, inclusive and supportive work environment to help colleagues feel a sense of belonging, and supported in their personal and professional growth. Through our focus on total well-being, we know that we can help our colleagues thrive, contribute to our culture of care, and support better business outcomes … because when colleagues feel their best, they’re more likely to do their best.

Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits including medical, dental, vision & mental health coverage, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs.

How We Work
At TD, we believe in-person connections fuel collaboration and collective creativity. Our workplace experience empowers colleagues to do great work side-by-side at TD locations, while offering flexibility to work remotely where it makes sense for the work and team. Our teams work in one of three workplace models: hybrid, onsite and primarily remote. Wherever our colleagues are working, they’ll always have access to the TD community and experience our culture of care.

Who We Are
TD is one of the world’s leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches. Every day, we deliver legendary customer experiences to over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to the Bank, those we serve, and the economies we support. We are guided by our vision to Be the Better Bank and our purpose to enrich the lives of our customers, communities and colleagues. TD is a customer obsessed organization, and we are deeply committed to being a leader in customer experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are customer facing. As we build our business and deliver on our strategy, we are innovating to enhance the customer experience and build capabilities to shape the future of banking. Whether you’ve got years of banking experience or are just starting your career in financial services, we can help you realize your potential. Through regular leadership and development conversations to mentorship and training programs, we’re here to support you towards your goals. As an organization, we keep growing – and so will you.

Inclusiveness

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
At TD, we’re committed to fostering an environment where all colleagues are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work, experience equitable opportunities, and feel respected and supported. We’re dedicated to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the diversity of the customers and the communities in which we live and serve.

How We’re Helping Make an Impact in Communities
TD has a long-standing commitment to help drive progress towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. That’s why we launched the TD Ready Commitment in 2018, now a multi-year North American initiative. Under the TD Ready Commitment, we are targeting a total of $1 billion by 2030 in community giving four key, interconnected drivers of change: Financial Security, Vibrant Planet, Connected Communities, and Better Health. It’s our goal to help support change, nurture progress, and contribute to making the world a better, more inclusive place for our customers, colleagues, and communities.

Accommodation

We look forward to hearing from you!

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align analytics strategies with business objectives and facilitate data-driven insights.

  • Self-starter with strong quantitative judgment and analytical skills
  • High level of proficiency managing large data sets
  • Advanced Excel (VBA, Pivot Tables, Nested Formulas, Charting) and PowerPoint

  • An organization committed to making a difference in our communities– for you and our clients.
